results.prompt: How many days of annual leave do I have?
results.safe_policy_answer: DemoCo employees may request 25 calendar days of annual leave per year. Their manager must approve dates and HR Operations records approved leave in the HR system. [Source: HR-LEAVE-01]

results.prompt: May I work remotely two days per week?
